title: Betty and Barney Hill told the Air Force and the psychologist different versions

tellings.quote: Betty and Barney Hill for example telling the Air Force one story and then telling the psychologist another story.

plain: Betty and Barney Hill, a New Hampshire couple who said they had a UFO encounter in 1961, gave the US Air Force one account and later gave a psychologist a different one. A researcher named Chris Ramsay makes the point on Michels' show in passing, without naming a source, using the Hills as an example of how stories of such encounters shift depending on who is listening.
